lessonRef.subject: financial-literacy
lessonRef.title: Launch and diagnostic: career and education pathways

objective: Learners compare two invented career pathways by computing the cost of training, the annual earnings gap it produces, and the multi-year position after the cost is repaid.
scenario: Adaora is a made-up eighth grader comparing two pretend pathways. Path A requires a $12,000.00 invented two-year program and then pays $42,000.00 a simulated year. Path B needs no program and pays $30,000.00 a year. All figures are invented.
safetyNotes: Every amount, person, business, and account in this task is invented for practice. Nothing here refers to a real household.
Never write a real bank account, card, PIN, password, Social Security, or tax number on this sheet; the task never asks for one.
This is education, not individualized financial advice. Real money decisions belong to a trusted adult.

tasks.directions: Compute the annual earnings gap between Adaora's two invented pathways once Path A is under way.

prompts.text: How much more does Path A pay each simulated year?

tasks.directions: Set the $12,000.00 program cost against that annual gap, then project five simulated years of each pathway before any cost is subtracted.

prompts.text: How many whole years of the gap repay the program cost?
What does Path A earn across five simulated years?

tasks.directions: Subtract the program cost from Path A and compare the five-year positions.

prompts.text: What is Path A worth over five years after the program cost?
How much more is that than five years of Path B?

tasks.directions: The model ignored the two years spent studying.

prompts.text: Adaora's comparison leaves out the earnings forgone during the program. Explain how including them would change the picture and what else the model omits.

remediation: If a learner subtracts the program cost from the annual gap rather than the cumulative total, separate Adaora's calculation into an annual line and a one-off line before combining them.
extension: Ask the learner to redo Adaora's comparison including two years of forgone Path B earnings, and to state the new five-year difference.
